def _spikes(x, y):
    i, j = np.triu_indices(len(x), 1)
    different = x[i] != x[j]
    i, j = (i[different], j[different])
    slopes = (y[j] - y[i]) / (x[j] - x[i])
    offsets = y[:, None] - x[:, None] * slopes
    errors = np.abs(offsets - np.median(offsets, axis=0))
    return errors[:, np.argmin(np.median(errors, axis=0))] > 3.0

def _design(tau, dt, time, past, hold, x):
    decay = np.exp(-dt[:, None] / tau)
    step = -np.expm1(-dt[:, None] / tau)
    memory = np.zeros((len(hold), 2))
    for j in range(len(dt)):
        memory = decay[j] * memory + step[j] * past[:, j, None]
    gap = hold[:, None] - memory
    transient = -np.expm1(-time[:, None] / tau)
    phi = time / (1 + 0.85 * time)
    drift = np.column_stack((np.ones(len(x)), x, np.sign(hold) * np.sqrt(np.abs(hold))))
    cross = gap[:, 0] - gap[:, 1]
    curves = np.concatenate((gap[:, None, :] * transient[None, :, :], drift[:, None, :] * phi[None, :, None], cross[:, None, None] * transient[None, :, :1]), axis=2)
    rates = np.column_stack((gap / tau, drift, cross / tau[0]))
    return (curves, rates)

def basis(logtau, dt, t, past, hold, x, act, log_rows):
    tau = np.exp(logtau)
    h = dt[:, None] / tau
    a = np.exp(-h)
    b = -np.expm1(-h)
    z = np.zeros((len(hold), 2))
    dz = np.zeros_like(z)
    for s in range(len(dt)):
        u = past[:, s, None]
        dz = a[s] * (dz + h[s] * (z - u))
        z = a[s] * z + b[s] * u
    gap = hold[:, None] - z
    k = t[:, None] / tau
    phi = -np.expm1(-k)
    dphi = -k * np.exp(-k)
    flow = np.where(log_rows[:, None], np.log1p(t), t)
    drift = np.column_stack((np.ones(len(hold)), x))
    av = act * hold
    c = np.concatenate((gap[:, None] * phi, drift[:, None] * flow[:, :, None], (av[:, None] * phi[:, 0])[:, :, None], ((act * z[:, 0])[:, None] * flow)[:, :, None]), axis=2)
    r = np.column_stack((gap / tau, drift, av / tau[0], act * z[:, 0]))
    dc = -dz[:, None] * phi + gap[:, None] * dphi
    dr = (-dz - gap) / tau
    ec = np.stack((av[:, None] * dphi[:, 0], (act * dz[:, 0])[:, None] * flow), axis=-1)
    er = np.column_stack((-av / tau[0], act * dz[:, 0]))
    return (c, r, dc, dr, ec, er)

def _basis(logtau, dt, t, past, hold, x):
    tau = np.exp(logtau)
    h = dt[:, None] / tau
    a = np.exp(-h)
    b = -np.expm1(-h)
    z = np.zeros((len(hold), 2))
    dz = np.zeros_like(z)
    for s in range(len(dt)):
        u = past[:, s, None]
        dz = a[s] * (dz + h[s] * (z - u))
        z = a[s] * z + b[s] * u
    gap = hold[:, None] - z
    k = t[:, None] / tau
    phi = -np.expm1(-k)
    dphi = -k * np.exp(-k)
    drift = np.column_stack((np.ones(len(hold)), x))
    curves = np.concatenate((gap[:, None, :] * phi, drift[:, None, :] * t[None, :, None]), axis=2)
    rates = np.column_stack((gap / tau, drift))
    dc = -dz[:, None, :] * phi + gap[:, None, :] * dphi
    dr = (-dz - gap) / tau
    return (curves, rates, dc, dr)
